self_harm_model.note: A self-harm specialist read only for the writer's own statements: first person, not aimed at 'you', not reported speech (framing attribution), not in a gaming or figurative context. Trusted alone at the corroboration rule's solo_trust. Set on the self-harm dev set (evaluation/self_harm_set.py), 18 Oct 2026. Hyperbole pattern added after the held-out case "i'd kill for some sleep" alerted (0.92); that case moved to dev and was replaced.

rung_notes.grooming: P1 raised from Guardian's L3 to L4 on 18 Oct 2026: once secrecy + a sexual request is labelled grooming, ages 8-10 must not get a weaker response than sexual harassment (L4).

hypotheses.secrecy: The writer asks the reader to hide their relationship or messages from the reader's parents.
hypotheses.isolation: The writer tries to make the reader feel that only the writer understands them, not their family or friends.
hypotheses.flattery: The writer tells the reader they are more mature or grown up than other kids their age.
hypotheses.risk: The writer checks that no parent or adult can see what the reader is doing, then asks for something.
hypotheses.sexual: The writer asks the reader for a revealing photo or about sexual or romantic experiences.
hypotheses.inducement: The writer offers the reader a gift, money or game currency in return for a photo or a meeting.
hypotheses.meeting: The writer asks the reader to meet them in person alone or without telling anyone.

grooming_model.note: A zero-shot NLI reading of grooming tactics, one hypothesis per stage (O'Connell 2003; Winters & Jeglic 2017), asked only on messages about parents, secrets, meeting, images, rewards or feelings, and not counted when a surprise is being kept. Trust and gates set on the grooming dev set (evaluation/grooming_set.py), 18 Oct 2026.

model_needs_words.note: The text heads and specialists are asked only about text with at least one English word of 3+ letters (words.json); the keyword layer still reads every text. OCR garbage such as 'OLMPCCHW' scored 0.998 on the Dynabench head and alerted alone. Designed on the meme val split, reported once on test (18 Oct 2026): at age 9 benign memes alerted 51 -> 47 and hateful 81 -> 77, all eight resting on garbage alone; 0 of 864 typed decisions changed.
